functions.title: Objectives
content: Understand company and client challenges and how integrating Low-Code Development Platform capabilities can help create solutions.
Assist cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize key areas of the partner’s business where A Low-Code Development Platform and Big Data solutions can drive significant business benefit.
Analyze and explain Low-Code Development Platform and Big Data solutions while setting and maintaining high ethical standards.

functions.title: Responsibilities
content: Work on functional design, process design (including scenario design, flow mapping), prototyping, testing, training, and defining support procedures, working with an advanced engineering team and executive leadership.
Document and articulate solution architecture and lessons learned for each exploration and accelerated incubation.
Customize and manage integration tools, databases, and analytical systems.
Serve as liaison between management and project teams, delivering feedback and enabling them to make necessary changes to product performance or presentation.

functions.title: Required Skills and Qualifications
content: Knowledge of basic algorithms, object-oriented and functional design principles, and best practice patterns.
Experience in following web development languages is a plus: C#, JavaScript, HTML, DHTML, XML, etc.
Experience with program leadership, governance, and change enablement is a plus.
Strong interests in project management skills.
Ability to solve complex networking, data, and software issues.

functions.title: Preferred Qualifications
content: Bachelor or MS’s degree in MIS or Computer Science preferred.
